correctness.rationale: With normalized semicircle measure, U_j are orthonormal eigenfunctions of L with λ_j=j(j+2). Clebsch–Gordan products give ∫U_m⁴=a, ∫U_n⁴=b, ∫U_m²U_n²=a; opposite parity makes cubic cross terms zero. Hence restricted sharp norm fourth power is e^-4λm t max_{0<=x<=1}[a(1-x)²+br²x²+6ar x(1-x)] with r=e^-2(λ_n-λ_m)t. Quadratic derivative gives strict mixed iff r>1/3 and r<3a/b, otherwise max pure with crossing r=sqrt(a/b). Branch values and equality cases follow, and monotonicity gives unique contractivity time. Independent bounded scalar optimization checked six opposite-parity pairs at six spectral ratios, including transition representatives. Algebraic proof establishes generality.
